title: Cloudflare Records 18.2 Million DDoS Attacks in Q3
excerpt: Cloudflare mitigated 18.2 million network-layer DDoS attacks in the third quarter of 2026, marking a 38% increase.
body_html:
Cloudflare released data showing a significant rise in distributed denial-of-service activity during the third quarter of 2026. According to the company, threat actors launched approximately 8,226 network-layer DDoS attacks every single hour.

During this period, the web infrastructure and security firm autonomously mitigated 18.2 million network-layer, or L3, DDoS attacks. This translates to roughly 197,400 attacks per day, or one attack every 0.44 seconds. In addition to network-layer incidents, the company handled 14.4 trillion HTTP DDoS requests throughout the quarter.
